comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures address the growth and drivers within their respective investment management or investment portfolios. Goldman Sachs (GS) attributes its investment management revenue growth specifically to higher average assets under supervision (AUS), reflecting business scale and fee generation. Morgan Stanley (MS) attributes changes in its investment sensitivity to specific new capital allocations in private credit and affordable housing. While MS focuses on risk sensitivity drivers from new fund investments, GS focuses on the financial performance outcome (revenue) driven by the scale of managed assets.
